headline: Obama order directs federal action to protect and restore the Chesapeake Bay.
what_it_does: This executive order focuses on protecting and restoring the Chesapeake Bay, a large estuary on the East Coast. It directs the federal government to take steps toward that goal. No summary was provided, so details about specific agency duties, deadlines, or rules are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies are directed to work on protecting and restoring the Chesapeake Bay.

who_it_affects.group: People and communities in the Chesapeake Bay region
who_it_affects.how: The order aims to improve the condition of the bay where they live, work, or fish.
